structured.reason: For any provider failure that is not already an LLMRouterError, the mutant returns None instead of a ProviderError. Raising None would then fail with a TypeError, so the provider's error would escape the public ProviderError boundary. That directly breaks REQ_PROVIDER_ERROR_BOUNDARY.
structured.test_focus: Make the provider fail with a raw HTTP or Google GenAI SDK exception and check that the caller gets a ProviderError carrying the provider, model and stable status metadata, with provider detail hidden and exactly one provider request made.
